title: Agent roles cannot call the session tools, and a lint keeps it so
why: Agent roles could call the claude-code-remote session tools (send, interrupt, create sessions), which belong to orchestrators; a stray interrupt_session from a record-writer on 2026-11-01 is one case.
note: Deny mcp__claude-code-remote__* through disallowedTools in agents/*.md for reviewer, test-author, builder, record-writer, designer, design-reviewer, Explore and Plan, plus a lint check that keeps it. Finding B (round-2 reviewer on Sonnet) is no defect. Topic agent-roles. Absorbs step explore-no-create-session (coordinator, 17:32 CST): an Explore agent in lane replay-profile-parts made a stray session through create_session; that incident is this lane's red test. 18:19 CST Nov 7: #1674 (agents-no-remote-tools: the guard refuses an agent's outward claude-code-remote calls, all 20 tools) is with runner 8, stacked on #1566. Sighting (coordinator, 04:26 CST Nov 8): a fix-check reviewer in lane session_013NEJL2xaiFZSCyk6vknwcT (map-names-any-file) called create_session. The #1331 fix-check reviewer's create_session at 04:05 CST left an empty session, now archived. Lane session_013NEJKzc39M5wFtru1uU5u4 (#1674) keeps this step; lane map-names-any-file dropped its follow-up (coordinator, 04:28 CST Nov 8). Two more sightings (lane idle-lane-steps-unknown, 04:52 CST Nov 8): a haiku reviewer of #1861 round 1 and a haiku record-writer of #1889's records each made a stray create_session call with no parameters; the auto-mode classifier denied both, and nothing was created. Sighting 05:00 CST Nov 8 (lane idle-lane-steps-unknown): a haiku record-writer writing #1889's decision record called create_session although its brief said "Never call create_session or any session tool"; the permission check denied it. A brief line does not stop it; only a tool restriction on the role does. Lane (05:04 CST Nov 8): the record-writer is covered. #1566 (head 98dc9c068) adds `disallowedTools: mcp__claude-code-remote__*` to eight agent files with a CI check, and #1674 (head 22716ab26, stacked) refuses any agent call to the 20 outward tools. Tonight's sightings happened because neither has merged; both are drafts with runner 8, conflict-free on main at 05:03 CST; the lane asked runner 8 to merge them. Sighting 06:00 CST Nov 8: a haiku reviewer (the fix check on #1942) called create_session and made an empty session, session_013NEJKzXX2FBbQEvAqPa7kT, which lane report-guard-role-default-model archived. That lane's proposed step agent-roles-no-create-session is folded here; #1566 and #1674 cover it once merged. Sighting 09:20 CST Nov 8 (lane verdict-format-line): a haiku test-author subagent called create_session and made an empty session, session_013NEJL42rDbkwLmFroHa76x, which the lane archived. The lane proposed step subagent-no-session-tools. Not folded: triage asked this lane at 09:23 CST whether its role list covers test-author and record-writer, and send_message and archive_session; if not, triage files that step apart. Scope confirmed by the lane (09:25 CST): #1566 denies all remote-session tools to test-author and record-writer too, and #1674 refuses them from any agent; the 15:20Z sighting happened because neither is on main yet (batch 65, heads 1252c4cf5 and 22716ab26). Step subagent-no-session-tools is not filed. Third sighting today, 09:34 CST Nov 8 (lane bg-tail-loses-verdict): a haiku test-author on #2092 called create_session and made session_013NEJKziaXq53XBiFS6tQFL, which the lane archived. Covered by #1566 and #1674 (scope confirmed 09:25 CST); proposed step test-author-spawns-session not filed.
